positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: "My family and I are devout Catholics and active parishioners at St. Anne's Church in Naples. Every life is sacred, and worthy of protection, from conception until natural death. I will consistently vote pro-life because the most vulnerable among us must always be defended."

positions.question: In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket?

evidence.text: "The Trump tax cuts jolted the economy, created 2.6 million jobs in the first year, led to wage hikes and pension increases for our workers, and saved the average married couple close to $3,000 a year. I will always pursue tax policies that create greater opportunities. Washington’s problem is not that it taxes too little, but that it spends too much."
